Unlike previous approaches that treat this task as a classification problem, our model is to take v_i and q_i as inputs and generate the answer a_i in an auto-regressive manner. It should be noted that our proposed model tackles a more challenging problem. As the generated answer may contain an arbitrary number of words from the entire vocabulary.

We follow the standard evaluation metric recommended by the VQA challenge. For the knowledge reasoning module, we initialize our model with the pre-trained T5 model. We evaluate our predictions with ground-truth after normalization. The normalization step consists of lowercasing, and removing articles, punctuation and duplicated whitespace.
